verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents dedicated usage-event ingestion (single and batch endpoints) suitable for metering pipelines, and idempotency keys are supported via a documented header for API requests generally. However, there is no explicit documentation of backdating/backfill support for usage events or of high-volume/real-time streaming throughput guarantees. Missing for 10: explicit backdating/timestamp-override support for usage events, evidence of high-volume streaming scale/rate limits, independent hands-on confirmation of idempotent behavior specifically on usage-event endpoints.
